# G. Collection (Gdot Collection)

> G. Collection is a premier lifestyle brand based in Pakistan. We specialize in elegant stitched and unstitched ladies' apparel featuring intricate embroidery, lace, fringes, and cutwork. We also offer a curated selection of bags and accessories. We provide nationwide delivery across Pakistan with Cash on Delivery (COD) and free shipping on orders above Rs. 10,000.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://alasra.online/): Explore our latest arrivals and featured collections.
- [About Us](https://alasra.online/about-us): Learn more about our brand and hand-finished details.
- [Contact Us](https://alasra.online/contact): Reach out via WhatsApp (+92 315 9258892) or email (support@alasra.online). Available Mon-Sat.
- [FAQs](https://alasra.online/faqs): Answers regarding ordering, shipping, sizes, and returns.
